parties.respondent: Regional Manager, Oriental Insurance Company Limited

summary: Motor accident compensation appeal; permanent disability 60%; loss of income calculation; notional income determination; future prospects at 40% per Pranay Sethi; multiplier 18; medical expenses for speech therapy and physiotherapy; attendant charges; non-pecuniary compensation; enhancement claims rejected; High Court partially allowed appeal increasing loss of income compensation.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upheld; compensation as modified by High Court confirmed.
